Paste the product photo here

On Amazon: right-click the main photo → Copy Image, then click this box and press Ctrl/⌘+V.
Or drag the photo in, or upload a screenshot.

Amazon doesn't let other websites read its pages, so the photo and size come from what you paste here. Products are saved in this browser under “My products”.
